guest_business.actuation: exact request/cookie correlation, stale/replayed request refusal, no successful receipt before native terminal success plus fresh at-target feedback

guest_business.retirement: Local abandonment does not acknowledge native cancellation; common runtime must separately retire native resources and generations.

intended_graph.static_pointer_library: Ordinary pointers remain within reader/planner private heap. Its C structs are local values, never serialized padding or addresses.

scope: Two independent intended guest trust domains; source/build targets do not establish actual runtime memory or permission isolation. This file is application development status, not a common deployment/channel ABI.
